1479-5700-5701-7705-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-7705-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

574-2374-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-2374-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

3755-4770-4927-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1070-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-5231.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

396-728-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
396-728-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2044-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-5295-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5060-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5060-5131-8095--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-5060-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-6823.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2301-2438-2738-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Abzan Ascendancy, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-6006-6970-7060-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-3388.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-3388.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-3388.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1496-2919-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-2919-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2961-3175-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

147-4050-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4050-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

1824-2530-2932-3771.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2932-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1824-2530-2932-3771.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Bontu's Monument trigger, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

3215-5412-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.

When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Naga Fleshcrafter.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.

339-677-1251-2511.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

784-1750-2793-5261-6798.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-1750-2793-5261-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn, triggering Silas Renn, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1651-3715-5365-6774.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-6774.description:

Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2645-3609-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
2645-3609-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Kilo.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
2645-3609-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well. This includes Staff of Domination's fourth ability, but this will cause much more mana to be required.

660-1356-1651-4574-6694.description:
Activate Treva's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Treva's Attendant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Oracle's Vault's second ability by tapping it, exiling Treva's Attendant from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn without playing its mana cost.
Cast Treva's Attendant from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and creating a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Treva's Attendant, untapping Oracle's Vault.
Repeat.

101-4067-4306-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

224-1671-1772-5478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

413-5276-5332-6524.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling All-Out Assault.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-2525-4681.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1669-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2724-3194.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Manta with haste.
The Wormfang Manta token's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, causing you to sacrifice Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3490-4659-5532.easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
3490-4659-5532.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures, one of which must be an artifact creature.
3490-4659-5532.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1940-4191-5010-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

1636-2857-4264.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-4264.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Altered Ego by paying {2}{G}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Altered Ego.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Altered Ego to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

3156-3558-4336-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crookshank Kobolds.
3156-3558-4336-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

719-2034-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-2034-4302.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Repeat.

819-1395-1980-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Elsha, Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2060-4751.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Verdurous Gearhulk.
1409-2060-4751.description:
Activate Verdurous Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator.
Resolve the Verdurous Gearhulk trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing itself and Verdurous Gearhulk.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1050-3149.description:
Activate Nevinyrral's Disk's ability to destroy all creatures artifacts and enchantments.
Your permanents have indestructible so they arent destroyed.
Repeat this on each of your turns.

1309-1987-2427-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1309-1987-2427-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

3485-4475.description:
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, Havoc Festival triggers, causing them to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of their end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent whose turn it is loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat during each other opponent's turn.
